alternatives.name: Modal
alternatives.why_not_default: No cloud workload was executed. Separate account, compute budget, region, durable storage and workload-cost acceptance remain unqualified; the demonstrated requirement is local application hosting.

alternatives.name: Docker Compose
alternatives.why_not_default: Declarative service packaging has no retained matched lifecycle comparison against the qualified native application. Engine selection, persistent state and recovery still require workload execution.

alternatives.name: BentoML
alternatives.why_not_default: No supplied model service, model call or cloud deployment was executed. Model packaging does not establish reproduction of this typed UI/API/database application.

alternatives.name: Docker Engine / Moby
alternatives.why_not_default: The retained review establishes no matched reproduction or recovery advantage for this workload. Rootless configuration documentation is not deployment acceptance; the application's separate container attempt does not qualify Moby.

alternatives.name: Podman / Quadlet
alternatives.why_not_default: No workload execution qualifies image compatibility, networking, persistent volumes or restart behavior. The documented systemd integration supports a prospective trial, not a measured improvement over the native application.

alternatives.name: Dev Containers CLI
alternatives.why_not_default: No container was built or executed. Its Feature lock omits base images and application dependencies, while daemon access, mounted state and account integration add unqualified operational boundaries.

alternatives.name: Dockerized IB Gateway
alternatives.why_not_default: This broker-specific supporting service does not host the typed application. Image identity, native sign-in, session restart, API connectivity and broker reconciliation remain unqualified in the retained review.

alternatives.name: React
alternatives.why_not_default: React participates in the successful Next.js browser workflow and remains an application dependency. It provides no separately demonstrated hosting or persistent-service capability beyond the selected Next.js component.

limits: This verdict reviews retained evidence; no application, database, container or provider workload was rerun.
Private raw logs referenced by hashes in the application receipt were not opened or independently verified.
Pinned Docker Compose, Moby and Dockerized IB Gateway README URLs were attempted but could not be fetched. Their assessment relies on the retained local source reviews.
Successful upstream documentation reads establish documented capabilities only, not workload acceptance. Mutable documentation was not treated as historical execution evidence.
open_gaps: Independent-host backup restoration, host-loss recovery and production authentication are not established.
The accepted database configuration uses loopback and local trust and omits TLS, ICU, readline and zlib; it does not qualify a production database profile.
No matched native-versus-container application comparison establishes deployment, recovery, isolation or operating-cost superiority.
Cloud hosting, remote-team access, GPU compatibility, production load and paid-provider acceptance remain unqualified.
The retained TypeScript generator incompatibility and initial container bind failure remain failures of their specific attempted configurations.
The WSL recipe records clean-build and TIME-WAIT issues with explicit recovery procedures; successful execution does not imply every historical recipe invocation succeeds unchanged.

arms: Selected locked Next.js/FastAPI/PostgreSQL application using owned native processes
The same application and assertions deployed through Docker Engine with Docker Compose
The same application and assertions deployed through Podman with Quadlet
overturn_protocol.metric: Require unchanged API and browser assertions, exact row/history equality after database and application restart, owned-process cleanup and explicit account/state boundaries. Compare clean reproduction failures and recovery effort; an alternative must close a demonstrated deployment gap without weakening these checks.

overturn_when: Change the verdict when an executed matched comparison using blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/acceptance-plan.json and the restart procedure in blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-application/README.md shows that another deployment arm preserves every application assertion and exact persisted state while resolving a demonstrated reproduction, isolation or recovery gap. Catalog agreement or source review alone is insufficient.
why_selected: Select FastAPI, Next.js and PostgreSQL as the demonstrated API, UI service and persistent-state stack. blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/receipt.json records native execution of the project-local integration on synthetic data: locked setup, 12 passing API checks, browser create/update, production build, exact record equality after database/application restart and owned-process cleanup. blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-application/README.md separately records the WSL run, including migration reversal and exact row/history persistence. These are local integration results using real upstream runtimes, not unchanged upstream test-suite acceptance. React remains the Next.js application's dependency. The hosting reviews supply no executed comparison establishing a better container or cloud default.
